pipeline.title: Electra aims to light up Nasdaq with IPO for phase 2/3 I&I push
pipeline.summary: The 2026 IPO streak continues as Electra Therapeutics has filed to go public to support its immunology and cancer pipeline.

pipeline.title: ESC26: AstraZeneca's heart failure drug shows promise in ph. 2 trial
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca’s oral relaxin agonist delivered encouraging phase 2b results in chronic heart failure, improving measures of cardiac function across two patient groups.

pipeline.title: ESC: AZ, Ionis' Wainua post-mortem throws water on silencer-plus-stabilizer approach in ATTR-CM
pipeline.summary: After a surprise washout in a recent phase 3 trial of AstraZeneca and Ionis’ antisense oligonucleotide Wainua, the likely reason for the miss is being laid bare, in a potential ill omen for others pursuing silencer drugs in transthyretin-mediated amyloid cardiomyopathy.

pipeline.title: BioNTech-Genentech cancer vax records more deaths than control in scrapped ph. 2 test
pipeline.summary: Following Merck and Moderna’s phase 3 triumph with a Keytruda-paired personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, a similar shot from BioNTech and Genentech has faltered in a reminder of the approach’s struggles as a standalone therapy.

pipeline.title: AusperBio adds $120M series C to advance hep B oligo therapy through phase 3 and beyond
pipeline.summary: AusperBio Therapeutics has raised $120 million in series C funds to advance its oligonucleotide therapy for chronic hepatitis B through phase 3 testing and hopefully on to commercialization.

pipeline.title: Lilly scores Novo-pressuring Mounjaro expansion to curb heart risks in diabetes patients
pipeline.summary: In their high-profile competition in the diabetes and obesity markets, Eli Lilly has proven adept at playing catch-up with Novo Nordisk. On Friday, Lilly checked another item off that list as it secured FDA approval for Mounjaro to reduce the risk of heart attack or stroke in at-

pipeline.title: Roche nabs expanded FDA approval for diagnostic tied to Jazz’s cancer drug
pipeline.summary: Roche has been given an extended clearance by the FDA for its tests that can find patients eligible to use Jazz Pharmaceuticals’ oncology med Ziihera.

pipeline.title: Akeso CEO looks beyond lung cancer with biliary tract win, counters ivonescimab debate
pipeline.summary: Fresh off a phase 3 win in biliary tract cancer, Akeso CEO Michelle Xia, Ph.D., is touting the PD-1xVEGF bispecific antibody ivonescimab’s ability beyond non-small cell lung cancer, even as she continues to defend the drug’s data against skepticism.

pipeline.title: Emergent re-ups Narcan education push across US, Canada on overdose awareness day
pipeline.summary: Emergent BioSolutions looks to expand awareness and education of its Narcan opioid overdose reversal spray with an expanded campaign that kicked off on International Overdose Awareness Day.

pipeline.title: Novartis, Bristol Myers pause autoimmune CAR-T trials due to safety concerns
pipeline.summary: Side effects observed in testing have led Novartis to halt development of rap-cel in multiple indications and Bristol Myers to voluntarily pause its zola-cel program.

pipeline.title: White House unveils next round of MFN pricing deals with 9 midsized drugmakers
pipeline.summary: Some four months after the White House inked the last of its expected drug pricing deals with 17 of the industry’s top players, the U.S. government is back for round 2, this time lining up agreements with a host of medium-sized biopharmas under President Trump’s ‘most favored nat

pipeline.title: UPDATED: Novartis halts autoimmune CAR-T trials after 3 deaths, as BMS also pauses studies
pipeline.summary: Three deaths have forced Novartis to pause development of its CD19 CAR-T candidate in autoimmune diseases, just as Bristol Myers Squibb has halted a similar program due to immune-related adverse events, Fierce has learned.

pipeline.title: Ascendis to pay 20% Yuviwel royalties in patent settlement with BioMarin
pipeline.summary: BioMarin now collects royalties on the more convenient competitor product. Ascendis will pay 20% of Yuviwel net sales in the U.S. dating back to the first commercial sales and through to May 2030.

pipeline.title: FDA OKs Takeda, Protagonist drug for rare blood cancer
pipeline.summary: The clearance and broader-than-expected label for Mimrylo open up a yearly revenue opportunity for Takeda that some analysts expect to reach $2 billion or more.

pipeline.title: CDMO Lonza hones commercial focus with company vet's return to new role
pipeline.summary: Samanta Cimitan, Ph.D., will serve in a newly created role as the CDMO's chief commercial officer, SVP and member of the extended executive committee starting Jan. 1, 2027.

pipeline.title: Lilly adds to immune drug pipeline with $2.9B Merida buyout
pipeline.summary: The big drugmaker’s latest company acquisition this year is centered around a technology designed to degrade proteins that malfunction in autoimmune disorders.

pipeline.title: ESC ‘26: Cytokinetics’ sell-off, Arrowhead’s edge and a heart drug autopsy
pipeline.summary: At a big meeting for cardiovascular medicines, Cytokinetics and Arrowhead aimed to separate their drugs from competitors while a failed study pressured Alnylam.

pipeline.title: FDA dings Alar over ‘extremely concerning’ ketamine claims
pipeline.summary: The FDA sent Alar Pharmaceuticals an untitled letter after finding fault with the company’s exhibit booth display and brochure at a recent conference.

pipeline.title: Jazz’s Ziihera secures 2nd survival win to solidify its HER2-positive stomach cancer status
pipeline.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals has added a second overall survival win to Ziihera’s cap, bolstering the bispecific’s claim as the new HER2 agent of choice in stomach cancer.

pipeline.title: B. Braun adds to a string of IV solution recalls in US
pipeline.summary: Late August has been rough for IV solution makers as B. Braun added to its recall tally once more, building on Baxter’s three recalls of similar products in the same time frame.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly inks $2.88B Merida buyout for autoimmune drugs against rogue antibodies
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has struck a deal to acquire Merida Biosciences for up to $2.875 billion, establishing a beachhead in efforts to treat disease through the selective degradation of pathogenic autoantibodies.

pipeline.title: Natera teams with Angiex on cancer drug trial monitoring
pipeline.summary: Natera inked a collaboration deal with biotech Angiex to assess the use of its Signatera blood test, which looks for small traces of cancer DNA in patients who have been diagnosed and treated for the disease.

pipeline.title: The next frontier: Advancing foundation models with multimodal data
pipeline.summary: What's possible when AI models can learn from additional health data modalities to create a more complete understanding of human health?

pipeline.title: Takeda bolsters blood cancer portfolio with FDA nod for Mimrylo in polycythemia vera
pipeline.summary: The FDA has approved Takeda’s Mimrylo (rusfertide) for polycythemia vera, introducing a new mechanism to the nonmalignant rare blood cancer and handing CEO Julie Kim another major regulatory win since taking the helm.

pipeline.title: On the 'cusp,' PharmaEssentia gains FDA label expansion for Besremi
pipeline.summary: The FDA has signed off on a label expansion for PharmaEssentia's Besremi, endorsing it as a treatment for the rare bone marrow disorder essential thrombocythemia.

pipeline.title: Moderna raises $2.6B to support cancer work; FDA clears updated COVID vaccines
pipeline.summary: Moderna’s upsized note offering quickly followed a big win in a crucial study. Elsewhere, a biotech’s shares tumbled after study data were “inadvertently” published ahead of a medical meeting.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca, Ionis data spark debate about RNA drugs’ impact on deadly heart disease
pipeline.summary: Results published in NEJM raised questions about the benefits “silencer” medications provide on top of standard therapies for TTR cardiomyopathy and amplified investor pressure on Alnylam.

pipeline.title: MrBeast, Snapchat, AI and more: Pharma marketing’s pulse check
pipeline.summary: In this week’s episode of “The Top Line,” Fierce’s Ben Adams and Zoey Becker discuss how pharma marketing is evolving across social media, creative work and agency strategy.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: Biotech’s rebound is undeniable
pipeline.summary: Not only is the XBI continuing to hover around a historic high, but drug companies can’t seem to get enough of both large IPOs and big-ticket M&A.

pipeline.title: Teva saddles up as stalking horse bidder for bankrupt BioXcel’s neuroscience portfolio
pipeline.summary: BioXcel Therapeutics has filed for bankruptcy and lined up a deal for Teva Pharmaceutical to acquire its assets for $57.5 million upfront.

pipeline.title: FDA green lights Priovant drug for rare skin disease
pipeline.summary: Lisraya’s clearance marks the first approval of a drug the Roivant subsidiary licensed from Pfizer and has since positioned against multiple rare inflammatory conditions.

pipeline.title: Biogen enlists lupus patient advocate to share social media story of resilience
pipeline.summary: Biogen highlighted patient advocate and content creator Naomi Rose’s story living with cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CLE) on its social media platforms.

pipeline.title: Omnicom PR consultancy injects new leadership into pharma push
pipeline.summary: Omnicom’s maslansky + partners has expanded its leadership team, hiring two new partners and expanding the role of a founding partner to strengthen its healthcare and life sciences practice.

pipeline.title: Genentech doubles down on ADC-resistant cancers with $1B DualityBio pact
pipeline.summary: Roche’s Genentech is paying DualityBio $45 million upfront for rights to antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) designed for the growing pool of patients who progress after treatment with the modality. The deal is worth more than $1 billion in potential milestones.

pipeline.title: Stephen Farquhar takes over as CEO of Publicis Health Media
pipeline.summary: Stephen Farquhar has taken over as CEO of Publicis Health Media (PHM), succeeding longtime Publicis executive Andrea Palmer.

pipeline.title: Priovant pushes ex-Pfizer asset across FDA finish line in rare skin and muscle disease
pipeline.summary: Though not without a bump along the way, Roivant-backed Priovant Therapeutics has pushed its dual TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor across the FDA finish line, securing its first approval in a rare skin disease.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Roche’s $2.5B obesity deal; Akeso CEO’s defense; Lawmaker’s reflection on China
pipeline.summary: Roche is taking a less-trodden path in obesity. Akeso CEO counters concerns over shrinking lung cancer data for ivonescimab. A U.S. congressman says China is "beating us on our ground game" in biotech. Plus more.

pipeline.title: ESC: Cytokinetics delves deeper on ‘huge’ Myqorzo readout, fueling cardiomyopathy expansion bid
pipeline.summary: Cytokinetics' cardiac myosin inhibitor, Myqorzo, is the first to demonstrate significant, clinically meaningful benefits in patients with a rare heart condition called non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. An approval for this indication could potentially double the pool o

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Vivace revs up C-suite ahead of pivotal push
pipeline.summary: Vivace Therapeutics has named Craig Gibbs, Ph.D., as its new president and CEO.

pipeline.title: Michael Polansky has a new, skin-focused biotech. Don’t call it a drug company.
pipeline.summary: Though its data could be useful for pharmaceutical firms, Polansky’s latest entrepreneurial endeavor, Outer Bio, is serious about steering clear of road bumps that slow biotechs.

pipeline.title: CEPI backs push to bring Egyptian biotech's Ebola vaccine into clinic to curb fast-growing outbreak
pipeline.summary: The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations has committed up to $16.5 million to push Minapharm’s Bundibugyo vaccine candidate into the clinic, furthering its response to the Ebola outbreak.

pipeline.title: Osivax bags flu vaccine rights to pursue combination shot vision
pipeline.summary: Osivax has licensed an influenza vaccine from GC Biopharma, positioning the biotech to build on early evidence that its midphase candidate complements traditional flu shots.

pipeline.title: Why real-world data is becoming a strategic asset in drug development
pipeline.summary: Labcorp's Catie Schlechter discusses how sponsors are using real-world data to improve trial design, recruitment and strategy.

pipeline.title: Flagship’s ProFound partners with Gates Foundation in $35M preeclampsia target discovery pact
pipeline.summary: Flagship Pioneering’s ProFound Therapeutics is keeping its string of high-profile partnerships going, forging a new pact with the Gates Foundation worth up to $35 million to find new drug targets for a dangerous pregnancy complication.

pipeline.title: China in Global Clinical Development: Why Early Inclusion Matters
pipeline.summary: Leading biotechs are rethinking China’s role in global clinical development. Early inclusion can unlock significant value.

pipeline.title: Gilead christens Bixlenvo with FDA nod for new HIV treatment combo tablet
pipeline.summary: Some 20 years after helping introduce the first once-daily single-tablet HIV regimen, Gilead Sciences has crossed the regulatory finish line with a new oral treatment option in the U.S.

pipeline.title: Research into protein interactions sheds new light on causes of autism
pipeline.summary: Studying protein-protein interactions might hold the key to identifying druggable targets for autism, a group of scientists at the University of California, San Francisco has suggested.

pipeline.title: FDA greenlights Revolution Medicines' pancreatic cancer gamechanger
pipeline.summary: Following dynamite data that earned a standing ovation at the American Society of Clinical Oncology meeting in May, Revolution Medicines’ Ras inhibitor daraxonrasib has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of metastatic pancreatic cancer.

pipeline.title: HCP media's endemic-versus-reach debate misses the real question
pipeline.summary: Endemic media and broad reach each do half the job. What makes them work together is not more spend, but a signal that says when.

pipeline.title: JATT mastermind launches latest biotech-focused SPAC via $60M IPO
pipeline.summary: Just two months after Someit Sidhu, M.D., succeeded in pairing off his second special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) with Talawar Therapeutics, the biotech entrepreneur is back at it again.

pipeline.title: Beyond the Bandwidth Ceiling: Redesigning Advanced Therapy Operating Models for the Digital Staff Era
pipeline.summary: Advanced therapy manufacturers are hitting a bandwidth ceiling. Deloitte makes the case for redesigning ops around AI 'digital staff.'

pipeline.title: After some ‘tough years,’ Frontier’s CEO is ramping up ambitions for precision med platform
pipeline.summary: After announcing the “tough but necessary” decision to lay off some employees last year, Frontier Medicines is looking to the future by advancing more cancer drugs into the clinic while continuing to find partners to leverage its AI proteomic platform.

pipeline.title: With mRNA back in the spotlight, tRNA shows potential to treat genetic disease
pipeline.summary: New research coming out of the University of Toronto has shown that transfer RNA may offer a promising therapeutic avenue for treating genetic diseases.

pipeline.title: The Clinician With 2 Million Followers Is Shaping Prescribing Behavior. Pharma Can Now Be Part of That Conversation
pipeline.summary: Millions of HCPs follow digital opinion leaders online. Here's how pharma can find, vet, and support the right ones in 2026.

pipeline.title: Pharma Doesn't Have an AI Problem. It Has an Information Problem.
pipeline.summary: Frontier Large Language Models have improved. More data became accessible. Neither solved the hardest questions. Here's what decision-grade pharma AI still needs.

pipeline.title: ‘A neuroscience revolution’: The GLP-like race to keep us awake and make billions doing it
pipeline.summary: As the hype around the vast medical potential of GLP-1 drugs continues unabated, another peptide is starting to make its own mark.

pipeline.title: Medigen links up with Charles River in push to take enterovirus vaccine global
pipeline.summary: Charles River Laboratories and Taiwan-based Medigen Vaccine Biologics are teaming up to advance Medigen’s multivalent enterovirus vaccine.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Lilly's Foundayo scripts cross 40K
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: AusperBio adds $120M; Abcuro secures $66M
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
